title: Observation
body:
This app is great; but I think it can be so much better. 

1. It be great if on my phone I could personalize my alerts. Meaning been able to set the days or month or however I want to set it. I don’t know why I’m able to do so on the mac but not in the phone 🤷🏻‍♂️

2. When I invite some to an event the app requieres me to have the exact iCloud mail o number that the other user has. It be great I could invite the other person by just using there phone number.
